audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields claim your point-and-click W stun 'lands inside Shroud'. Riot's own text: inside Twilight Shroud Akali is 'invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — a targeted W cannot grab her until she reveals by attacking or casting. Also: no cooldown numbers in breakdown.cooldowns; Perfect Execution's recast execute never tied to advice.

edits.before: Akali gets Perfect Execution (R) dashes, but you already outrange her all-in with your own point-and-click stun. edits.after: Akali gets Perfect Execution (R) dashes, but Shroud makes her unselectable — your point-and-click W cannot grab her inside the smoke. Hold the combo: attacking or casting briefly reveals her, and her R first cast commits to melee range, so stun the reveal and E-block the execute recast to flip her engage.

edits.before: Even late you keep favour because your W stun cuts through her Shroud mobility and locks her for your team. She's slippery in fights, but you're the reliable answer to assassins who rely on repositioning. Flank, stun on her commit, and delete her before she can reset.
edits.after: Even late you keep favour: she must enter melee to kill, and that is where your W stun and Aegis live. She is unselectable inside Shroud, so hold the stun for the reveal when she attacks. Flank, stun her commit, and delete her before Perfect Execution's second dash resets her.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are your kill zone; the full E-W-Q combo bursts her before her passive shield or Q heal can bail her out, and your W stun still lands inside her Shroud once you're on her. Force all-ins on cooldown and choke her farm so she never snowballs.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are your kill zone; the full E-W-Q combo bursts her before her passive shield or Q heal can bail her out. In Shroud she is unselectable — hold W for the reveal when she attacks. Force all-ins on its 20s cooldown and choke her farm so she never snowballs.
